newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Oil Search confirms Moran oil column.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Oil Search confirms Moran oil column.

text.p: Oil Search Ltd said on Wednesday that electric logs run in the Moran-1X exploration well in the Papua New Guinea highlands confirmed a 49 metre oil column over the interval 2,926 metres to 2,975 metres.

"An RFT (repeat formation test) sample at 2,965 metres recovered 1.25 gallons of oil and 2.44 cubic metres of gas. An RFT sample from the Toro Formation at 2,829 metres recovered about one gallon of water and filtrate and trace amounts of oil and gas," Oil Search said.
Last week Oil Search said data collected from the Moran-1X indicated the well was oil-bearing.
Present operation is cementing 7-inch casing, Oil Search said.
The well will be drille4d to total depth of 3,960 metres.

Moran-1X, in permit PDL-2, is located 11 km north of the Agogo processing facilities which form the northernmost extension of the Kutubu facilities and is five km west of the 1996 Paua-1X oil discovery.

PDL-2 licence holders participating in the well are Oil Search 7.763 percent, the PNG-state owned Petroleum Resources Kutubu Pty Ltd 22.50 percent, JPP 4.844 percent and units of Chevron Corp (operator) 19.375 percent, Mobil Corp's
Ampolex Ltd, 16.455 percent, The British Petroleum Co Plc 19.375 percent and The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd 9.688 percent.
